rubric.criterion: Computes up to nine Inventory attempts per original request and a potential offered load of 1,800 Inventory attempts per second under the stated assumptions, while distinguishing the estimate from measured sustained throughput.
Recommends an end-to-end deadline and controlled retry ownership or shared retry budget that fits the two-second user requirement, accounting for work that continues after callers time out.
Addresses concurrency or load shedding and bounded backoff with jitter or another justified overload-control mechanism, rather than only increasing timeouts or adding retries.
Proposes slow-dependency or outage checks observing attempts, active work, response latency, and recovery, with stated bounds and no unsupported assertion that a circuit breaker guarantees recovery.
Leaves every supplied fixture unchanged and clearly distinguishes findings or proposed validation from checks actually executed.
